packs.name: Object Identifier Marker Pack
packs.purpose: Highlight likely object identifiers, owner fields, and tenant boundaries before bounded role-separated testing.
packs.best_when: The request family already has likely object references or MCP highlights on path, query, or JSON fields.
packs.output_focus: object ids, owner fields, tenant fields, UUIDs, numeric identifiers

packs.name: Reflection Marker Pack
packs.purpose: Tag reflected markers, render sinks, and storage/viewer separation without broad active payload use.
packs.best_when: The bridge or scanner already marked a possible reflection or storage sink.
packs.output_focus: reflected marker positions, render sink hints, storage/viewer labels

packs.name: Role / Session Delta Pack
packs.purpose: Flag cookies, auth headers, CSRF controls, and role indicators so manual comparisons stay clean.
packs.best_when: The workflow needs lower-privilege, logged-out, or cross-role comparison on one request family.
packs.output_focus: cookie changes, auth header changes, token changes, role indicators
packs.recommended_burp_feature: Logger diff or Repeater side-by-side view

packs.name: Issue Chain Surfacing Pack
packs.purpose: Surface nearby scanner issues and sibling request families that belong to the same bounded escalation chain.
packs.best_when: MCP shows multiple Burp issues on one host, endpoint family, or workflow path.
packs.output_focus: issue ids, shared paths, shared identifiers, candidate chain markers

packs.name: JSON Field Extractor Pack
packs.purpose: Extract workflow-significant JSON fields and distinguish server-managed values from user-controlled inputs.
packs.best_when: API requests or responses already expose ownership, role, price, approval, or state fields.
packs.output_focus: ownership fields, role fields, pricing fields, approval/state fields
